rows.25:7418:
Silence went on...
Even so, he {f:must have had|surely had} something on his mind.
{f:I|I} decided to keep him company for a while.
Little by little, I could feel saliva pooling in {f:my|my} mouth.
{f:I|I} swallowed without meaning to.
"Gulp."
Oh, no!
I never thought it would be that loud...{p}
rows.25:7564:
{f:I|I} glanced at Shindo.
He slowly turned to look at {f:me|me} as well.
Shindo smiled and said,
"Hey, take a look down there."
{f:I|I} looked down as he told me to.{p}
rows.25:7774:
"Truth is, I've taken a liking to you.
Figured I'd take you along with me."
Shindo had lost his mind!
"{f:Somebody help me|Help}!"
{f:I|I} screamed on reflex.
"Hahaha, screaming won't do you any good.
Everyone's asleep right out there."
That's what he said.
The next moment, {f:I|I} gasped.{p}
rows.25:78a4:
What stood in front of {f:me|me} wasn't Shindo, but a cockroach in human form.
The cockroach was twirling its antennae round and round.
Its glistening black skin and the jagged spikes on its arms were sickeningly vivid.
"I've taken control of this guy's body.
Most of the time I still keep a human form.

Fwahahaha!"
That's what {f:the thing|the cockroach} said.
Then... would Shindo's body someday stay like this and never return to normal{f:?|?}
I couldn't just leave Shindo like this{f:.|.}
{f:I've got to be brave!|I have to be brave!}☆{p}
rows.25:7ac8:
{f:I|I} steeled myself and tackled him hard.
"Gwagh!"
As he staggered, something hazy burst out of his mouth and nose.
The hazy thing floated in the air for a while, then quickly vanished down the hole in the toilet.{p}
rows.25:7bc0:
"Uh... uhhh..."
Now that the strange thing had left him, Shindo seemed to be back to his old self.
"Shindo, pull yourself together!☆"
"Why am I lying here?"
Shindo said.
Apparently he had no memory of the time he'd taken on {f:that thing's|that} form.
{f:I|I} unlocked the stall and hurried to drag Shindo out.{p}
rows.25:7d24:
Then I woke up everyone who was lying there.
"Let's get out of here, quick!"
{f:I|I} hurried everyone along.
With a bad feeling, {f:I|I} looked back...
And there...{p}
rows.25:7efc:
We all rushed out into the hallway and slammed the restroom door shut as hard as we could.
Having lost their target, the cockroaches rustled and scrabbled on the other side of the door.
"Let's hurry back to the club room!☆"
{f:We|We} ran off in a blind frenzy.
At that moment, {f:I|I} felt my mission as a member of the newspaper club.
Telling myself that this was exactly how a scary story should be...
To an onlooker, {f:I|I} might seem like someone with unbelievable nerves.
After this, I can hardly go calling other people weird{f:, can I|, can I}.
"Of course, we're still going to keep the scary stories going.
So be ready for it!"
That's what {f:I|I} was telling everyone as I ran.{p}
rows.25:8148:
"You feel a spirit?
Then where in here do you feel it from?"
Hosoda asked {f:me|me}, looking pleased with himself.
"From that toilet over there..."
{f:I|I} pointed.{p}
rows.25:8208:
And it was true: I wasn't joking, I really did sense something from there.
Then came a sound from the toilet: splish... splosh...
"{f:What's that|What was that}?"
Hosoda and {f:I|I} fearfully peered in.
"Huh?★"{p}
rows.25:848c:
I slowly followed his gaze.
At the end of it was Hosoda, his eyes wide open as if he were paralyzed.
{f:I|I} called out to him in a panic.
"Hosoda, what's wrong?!
You're drenched in sweat!"
He must have been absolutely terrified.{p}
rows.25:8564:
"It wasn't like that, it wasn't like that!☆
I... I...☆
I'm truly sorry!☆
Nakano, please forgive me."{p}
rows.25:8708:
"Hosoda!☆"
{f:I|I} ran over and shook him.
He writhed around for a while, then suddenly his eyes snapped open and he sprang to his feet.
As I stood there stunned, he said this to {f:me|me}.{p}
rows.25:87ec:
"Ahh, I feel so refreshed somehow.
I feel wonderful, {a}{f:|}.
I've been tormented over him all this time, but I'm all right now.
He was just lonely and wanted to be with me.
From now on, he'll live on inside me."{p}
rows.25:88d8:
{f:I|I} didn't really understand what he meant, and just stood there blankly.
Then Hosoda explained.
{f:He said|It turned out} the man from before was a friend of his who had died in an accident some time ago.
Yes, in the restroom...
Hosoda had been there at the time, but there was nothing he could do for him, he said.
It seemed Hosoda had been tormented by it ever since.{p}
rows.25:8a4c:
"Let's end the restroom tour here...
Come on, let's go back to the club room and hear the rest of the stories!"
What is with Hosoda, anyway...
Oh, well.{p}
rows.25:8ae8:
"Whaaat?★
You feel it?
I see, that's great.
So, which stall do you feel it from?"
Hosoda asked {f:me|me}, looking pleased with himself.
"From that toilet over there..."
{f:I|I} pointed at the stall closest to the window.
"Is that so? Then let's go in together."
{f:Hosoda looked|Hosoda looked} {f:delighted.|thrilled.}
"Excuuuse meee!
Please let the two of us be alone!
Thank you for your cooperatiooon!"

Someone clicked their tongue.

rows.25:8cd8: Then, practically shoved in by him, {f:I|I} went into the stall.
rows.25:8d28:
Hosoda locked the door with a click.
There was a window in the stall.

"Now, {a}{f:|}, feel the spirit more.
Close your eyes.
Sharpen your senses."
That's what Hosoda said.{p}
rows.25:8e14:
For the moment, {f:I|I} did as he said and closed my eyes.
...Some time passed.
All {f:I|I} could hear was water dripping from the faucet.

{f:I|I} whispered to him.
"Shh! Quiet!"
Hosoda scolded {f:me|me}.
rows.25:8f48: Suddenly, BANG!☆ BANG!☆ There was a sound like someone pounding on the wall.{p}
rows.25:8f98:

Hosoda {f:seemed|looked} even more startled than {f:me|me}.
rows.25:9060:

rows.25:90e8:

No, it wasn't my imagination.
rows.25:9144: The sound really was getting louder.{p}
rows.25:917c:
"Hosoda, we'd better get out of here!"
{f:I|I} urged him.
rows.25:91cc:
"B-but the lock... It won't open!"
{f:All he can do is|All he could do was} flounder about in a panic.
rows.25:9298: But no matter how much we called or screamed, there was no sign of the seniors, who were supposed to be in the hallway, coming to help us.
rows.25:943c:
"★"

Neither of us could make a sound; we just stood frozen.{p}

{f:We|We} listened to her story in gloomy silence.
If only she'd told {f:us|us} before we went into the restroom.

{f:I|I} trudged back to the club room with everyone.{p}

"So you do feel it?
